suspended_reason: The cause is a D4Z4 MACROSATELLITE-REPEAT CONTRACTION with CHROMATIN DEREPRESSION of the DUX4 retrogene -- NOT a single-gene promoter switch. The D4Z4 array at 4q35 is normally heavily methylated and silenced. In FSHD1 (~95%) the array is CONTRACTED from the normal ~11-100 repeat units to 1-10 units, which lowers repeat-array methylation; in FSHD2 (~5%) loss-of-function of a chromatin repressor acting in trans on the array (SMCHD1, or DNMT3B / LRIF1) hypomethylates it. In BOTH cases, ONLY on a permissive distal 4qA haplotype that supplies a polyadenylation signal stabilising the DUX4 transcript from the last repeat unit, the normally-silenced DUX4 transcription factor is aberrantly expressed in skeletal muscle -> a toxic early-embryonic gene programme -> myofibre death (progressive facial, scapular and humeral weakness). The disease is therefore DEFINED by a repeat-array COPY-NUMBER + METHYLATION (chromatin) state plus a haplotype-supplied distal polyA signal -- there is no analyzable single-gene gamma shift to read as a promoter switch: in FSHD1 there is no causal single-gene promoter lesion at all (the lesion is a repeat contraction), and in FSHD2 the causal change is a trans-acting chromatin-modifier's LOSS whose pathogenic effect is the downstream D4Z4/DUX4 derepression, not its own promoter threshold. A strand-symmetric single-promoter gamma read cannot capture macrosatellite copy number, array methylation, trans-acting chromatin state, or a haplotype-supplied polyA. Held per the author's rule (no analyzable single-gene promoter DNA -> hold). This is a FOURTH held mechanism class -- distinct from WHOLE-CHROMOSOME ANEUPLOIDY (Down), LARGE-REGION IMPRINTING (Prader-Willi / Angelman 15q11-q13, Beckwith-Wiedemann 11p15.5), and now REPEAT-CONTRACTION / CHROMATIN-DEREPRESSION (D4Z4 / DUX4) -- demonstrating the suspension rule generalises across the major non-single-gene lesion mechanisms (aneuploidy, imprinting, repeat-derepression). A repeat-array / chromatin-state / DUX4-derepression model is future work, not a single-switch emergence.
discipline: no analyzable single-gene DNA read -> held (author's rule). Disclosed, not dropped.
